follow_ups.title: Catalog.API GetItemById returns the 400 for non-positive ids via BadRequest<ProblemDetails> (application/json)
follow_ups.reason: Lesson L2 requires TypedResults.Problem so the content type is application/problem+json and matches the OpenAPI document.

follow_ups.title: WebApp: URLs that match no page return an empty 404 body
follow_ups.reason: The WebApp has no status-code-pages handling, so on .NET 10 any unknown URL gives a blank page with a 404.
